source: Role-tier literacy matrix from Devlin Peck's AI Literacy Rollout Kit (devlinpeck.com, free to share). Baseline = the shared foundation; deep = role-specific depth with hands-on practice.

knowledge.label: Knowledge workers
knowledge.format: Hands-on workshops using real work samples

managers.label: People managers
managers.format: Cohort sessions plus realistic practice conversations
managers.note: Responsible use is taught as team norms.

executives.label: Executives
executives.format: Executive briefings, scenario reviews with the leadership team
executives.note: Start where the fear is: understanding when and why AI fails lets leaders set guardrails and move.

builders.label: Technical builders
builders.note: Plus engineering depth beyond the framework.
